run_voc_eval: run PASCAL VOC evaluation on detection results against ground truth annotations to compute AP
parse_rec_xml: parse a PASCAL VOC XML annotation file and return a list of object bounding box records
compute_voc_ap: compute the VOC average precision from precision and recall arrays using the 11-point or interpolated method
review_voc_eval_iou: review the voc_eval function IoU overlap computation logic for true positive and false positive classification
refactor_voc_eval_pickle: refactor the voc_eval function to use modern pickle instead of cPickle for caching annotations
